data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 32a5985802fed61954aa304cf6d6638445a8953b (defect introduced by cca8 DD1, commit cded6d29d3; on origin/main)
* **Component:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh — _phase_merge publish block (_sync_branch_against_default + _publish_rebased_branch). Origin: cca8-f1ed-ddd3-48f1 DD1 (rebase-not-merge).

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent/Workflow Blocker (observed live 3x: cca8 PR #662/#664; 3ebb PR #672->#673)

#### Expected Behavior
When origin/main advances during the PR2 (staged-*->main) phase, merge-to-main should proceed to land the (already-reviewed) staged content — GitHub's PR2 rebase-merge replays staged onto current main at merge time.

#### Actual Behavior
In _phase_merge, the PR2 phase runs with BRANCH=staged-*. When main advanced after the staged ref was created, _sync_branch_against_default rebased the staged ref (set _SYNCED_VIA_REBASE=1) and _publish_rebased_branch FORCE-PUSHED it. The staged-* ruleset (16961402) requires the review-sub-pr status check on every push; that check (ci.yml job) only runs on pull_request events, NEVER on a push, so the force-push is structurally un-satisfiable -> 'GH013 ... Required status check review-sub-pr is expected' -> the pipeline emitted CONFLICT_DATA{resolution_strategy:pr-create-failed} and exited 1, with no automated recovery. cca8 DD1 added this second direct-push-to-staged site WITHOUT the staged-* guard that already exists at the sibling site _phase_source_branch_version_bump (the version-bump push) — a 'lesson learned at one site, not propagated to a sibling' defect.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* merge-to-main two-tier flow (ADR-0020); staged-* ruleset 16961402; cca8 DD1 (_publish_rebased_branch / _sync_branch_against_default).

#### Resolution
FIXED on branch story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/3ebb-resilience-dd123-4, commit 9598f21fae (vetted via the epic 3-lens panel + convergence reviewer): _phase_merge now SKIPs the entire publish block for staged-* promotions (_branch_is_staged_promotion predicate), and a true PR2 conflict is a determinate re-stage error (not fp-recovery). Lands when 3ebb lands on main — CLOSE THIS BUG at that point. Recorded against cca8 so cca8-DD1 cannot close over this known gap.
data.title: [merge-to-main-pr.sh]: PR2-phase staged-* force-push is rejected by the sub-PR ruleset -> promotion dies when main advances mid-flight
